title: Social Humanoid: Socially Responsive Human-Humanoid Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2611.08407v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid robots are typically trained as solitary agents, leaving them unable to coordinate physically with human partners who naturally anticipate and adjust to one another. To bridge this gap, we present Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system that generates and executes socially responsive whole-body motion on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 conditioned on a human partner's motion. Its high-level policy performs flexible sequence modeling of human and humanoid motion through a shared tokenized representation, generating reactive humanoid motion and anticipating the partner's motion when they are occluded, while a low-level whole-body tracking controller executes the generated motion on the robot. To train the system, we introduce a two-phase adaptive retargeting procedure that retargets one interaction partner to the robot while morphing the other partner to preserve contact dynamics, reachability, and relative body scale. translated_title: 社会人形机器人：具有社会响应性的人-人形机器人交互
translated_abstract: 人形机器人通常被训练为孤立智能体，导致它们无法与人类伙伴进行物理协调，而人类伙伴之间会自然地相互预判并做出调整。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 Social Humanoid，这是一个分层系统，能够以人类伙伴的动作作为条件，在29自由度的宇树G1机器人上生成并执行具有社会响应性的全身运动。其高层策略通过共享的标记化表示对人形机器人与人类的动作进行灵活的序列建模，生成具有反应性的人形机器人动作，并在伙伴被遮挡时预判其运动；低层全身跟踪控制器则在机器人上执行生成的动作。为了训练该系统，我们引入了一种两阶段自适应重定向方法，将其中一个交互伙伴重定向到机器人上，同时对另一个伙伴进行形态变换，以保持接触动力学、可达性和相对身体比例。我们应用这一程序……
tldr: 提出Social Humanoid分层系统，通过共享标记化表示的动作序列建模和两阶段自适应重定向训练方法，使29自由度人形机器人能够根据人类伙伴的动作生成具有社会响应性的全身运动，从而实现真正的人机物理协调互动。
en_tdlr: Social Humanoid is a hierarchical system that enables a 29-DoF humanoid robot to generate socially responsive whole-body motion conditioned on a human partner's motion, trained via a two-phase adaptive retargeting procedure with shared tokenized sequence modeling.
